title: Page 2
content_zh:
白薇秀起初是透过学姊的介绍，误打误撞接触到婚礼企划顾问这个行业，当时她顿觉眼睛一亮，彷佛预见了未来，大二开始就在婚顾店打工，而许安安和她是大学同学，两人都是学服装设计的，许安安本来没什么太大的兴趣，后来是因为发现白薇秀打工的店里有某位男员工是他梦寐以求的天菜，于是也跟着到婚顾店打工，没想到做着做着倒也做出兴趣来了，就在那名男员工娶别的女人当老婆的那一晚，白薇秀陪着许安安大醉一场，也就是那一晚，他们发誓毕业后要自己开一间婚顾店。

初生之犊不畏虎，说的大概就是他们吧。

许安安的家境好，拿出一笔钱不成问题，但白薇秀就不同了，她大学打工三年省吃俭用，再加上双亲给的创业基金，其实她拿得很不好意思，毕竟双亲赚的也是辛苦钱，她暗自发誓，以后一定会加上利息还回去。

就这样，凭着打工三年累积的人脉跟经验，再加上他们花了一大笔钱在店内的装潢上，他们知道门面相当重要，新人准备结婚了，眼里看的、心里想的绝对是要最美好的，婚顾店如果不装潢得浪漫一点、有气质一点，客人是绝对看不上眼的，终于，“一生一世婚顾店”在新庄某条租金还算可以的街道上开幕了。

初期，店里就只有白薇秀跟许安安两个人，为了亲戚帮忙介绍，再用折断手脚的折数给对方折扣，至于下班后也不能休息，得抓紧时间制作网页，利用网路大肆宣传。

于是，好评价就这么传开了，这年头网路无远弗届就是有这个好处，有好口碑再加上刻意宣传，“一生一世”成立还不到一年就开始赚钱。

不过会这么顺利，白薇秀免不了还是要自我臭屁一下，要不是她时时刻刻精打细算，这个不行，太贵，那边不行，要省一点，“一生一世”恐怕不会那么快就朝赚钱的方向前进。

是的，钱！

她白薇秀这辈子最爱的就是钱，她从不把钱当钱看，而是当命看！每次看着存折的数字又往上增加，她的心情就会无比雀跃，每当不得已得去领钱出来花用时，她的心就不停的淌血。

钱！她需要赚钱！赚很多的钱！因为她还有很多目标未达成。

她需要钱还给父亲，需要钱出国进修，因为学的是服装设计，她对于白纱跟新娘造型这方面保有高度兴趣，也想要学得更多，让自己在婚顾师的层级更往上一步。

想着想着，白薇秀的眼睛不自觉又冒出两个＄的符号。

可是该死的，眼看结婚的淡季就要到来，店里的伙伴们却仍一副无感的模样，这教她这半个老板情何以堪啊！

许安安、小真、育德，还有两个工读生妹妹，看着坠入自我悲情情境中的白薇秀，又是皱眉，又是嘴角抽搐，又是激动的双手握拳，还有她那蓦地闪亮却又突然黯淡下来的双眸，以他们对她的了解，知道她又想起了此生的最爱—— 钱！

许安安摇摇头，挥挥手，要其他人各自忙去，就算没事忙，也要找事忙，接着转头对着白薇秀劝道：“我说薇秀啊，你爱钱的毛病可不可以改一改？”爱钱不是病，但爱钱爱到比命还重，就有点问题了。

许安安很认真的将好同学兼好朋友兼合作伙伴从头到脚打量了好几遍。

白薇秀一头乌黑柔亮长发披肩，自己剪得很工整的浏海，配上标准的鹅蛋脸，五官虽称不上艳绝之色，但组合起来却又相当完美，以他看女人挑剔的目光，可说是中等略上之姿。

最教人嫉妒的是她吹弹可破的雪白肌肤，不知道的人可能会以为她三天两头就跑美肤店保养，要不然就是砸重金买昂贵的保养品，错了，钱奴白薇秀怎么可能花得下手，她的好肌肤完全是天生丽质，要好好感谢她老妈，她每天顶多用洗面乳清洁一下，再拍拍化妆水，冬天顶多多抹个乳液，让脸颊不至于太干燥，如此而已，要不是因为化妆是身为婚顾师接待客人的基本礼貌，她恐怕会每天都素颜来上班。

而且创店之际白薇秀就非常坚持要订做制服，理由是这才会让人感觉到婚顾店人员的专业，他是觉得她的想法挺好的，但有时又忍不住会想，白薇秀八成是为了省去治装的烦恼跟花费，瞧瞧，夏、冬两季各三款样式的制服，上班时候轮着穿，可以省下多少治装费啊，不愧是精打细算的高手，他真是万般佩服。

好吧，他又离题了，回归正题。

眼前白薇秀穿着短袖立领旗袍式剪裁的合身紫色制服，将她窈窕的身材表露无遗，说起她的身材，啧啧，比她吹弹可破的肌肤更教人嫉妒，眼红到发火，以他不爱女人、把女人当成同类比较的心态跟目光，都不得不竖起大拇指说赞。

白薇秀满高的，约一六八，体重约五十公斤，而且肉都长在该长的地方，例如胸部跟臀部，而不该长肉的地方，像是腰跟大腿，都纤细到不像话，完完全全是胸大、纤腰、盈臀、长腿的超绝佳组合。

对了，有句台语是这样说的，“奶澎腰束卡称顶扣扣。”请原谅台语很差的他，但这真的是白薇秀的最佳形容词。

试问：这样的尤物，男人怎么可能忽略放过她呢？当然不可能！

据他所知，追她的男人没有一打至少也有半打，可这小姐打从大学时期的恋情结束之后，就忙着工作赚钱，再也没见她对男人提起什么兴趣。

反观他，虽然开了店，工作也忙，恋情却从不曾停止，因为他深信爱情是保持活力的最佳调剂品。

“钱固然重要，但爱情却是必要，你别成天在钱堆里打转，看看那些想追求你的男人，跟他们出去吃个饭、喝个咖啡，调剂一下。”

第1章(2)

有那么一瞬间，白薇秀有些茫然，原因是，话题怎么一下子从钱转移到男人身上？这两样东西在她心里的比重，可是完全不一样的。

过了一会儿，她傻傻的反问：“为什么？”

许安安气得差点拧下她的头，没好气的恐吓，“还问我为什么 再这样下去，你的女性荷尔蒙会失调，整脸会长满痘子，丑死你说。”

“不是吧，有男人才会身心状况失调，谈恋爱多麻烦，吃饭喝咖啡看电影帮对方挑礼物过一大堆纪念日，哪样不花钱？而且搞不好结果还是个大悲剧。”像她大学时期谈的两段恋情，还不是一开始甜蜜蜜，最终男朋友劈腿惨兮兮。

“白薇秀，你真的没救了！”

“许安安，我是真的没救了你又不是不知道！”白薇秀翻了个大白眼。

许安安气到跺脚。这又是白薇秀另一个个性上的缺失，她啊，在客户跟不熟的人面前，总是一副好脾气、好相处的模样，就算遇到奥客，也都能保持温柔的笑意，尽可能满足对方的需求，但跟她相熟的人，更别说他这个多年好友，常会被她翻脸不认还有粗鲁直爽的程度给气得咬牙切齿。

当然，这不是说白薇秀人不好，她对待朋友很真诚又有义气，只是前后的态度转变，真的可以荣登奥斯卡最佳女主角了。

“白薇秀，你在客人前装那温柔无比的态度，跟你的本性也差太多了，我真担心有天你会精神分裂。”
content_en:
Bai Weixiu first came into contact with the wedding planning consultant industry through the introduction of her senior sister. At that time, her eyes suddenly lit up, as if she had foreseen the future. She started working in a wedding consulting shop since her sophomore year. Xu Anan and she were college classmates. They both studied fashion design. Xu Anan didn't have much interest in it at first, but later she discovered Bai Weixiu.There was a certain male employee in the shop where Weixiu worked, who was his dream dish, so he also worked in a wedding shop. Unexpectedly, he also became interested in it. On the night when the male employee married another woman, Bai Weixiu got drunk with Xu Anan. On that night, they vowed to open a wedding shop of their own after graduation.

A newborn calf is not afraid of a tiger, so that’s probably them.

Xu Anan's family was well off, so it was not a problem to come up with a sum of money, but Bai Weixiu was different. She worked frugally for three years in college, plus the entrepreneurial funds given by her parents. She was actually very embarrassed to take it. After all, her parents earned hard-earned money. She secretly vowed to pay it back with interest in the future.

In this way, with the connections and experience accumulated during three years of working, and the fact that they spent a lot of money on the decoration of the store, they know that the appearance is very important. When a couple is getting married, they must see and think about the best. If the wedding shop is not decorated to be more romantic and elegant, customers will definitely look down on it. Finally, "Lifetime Wedding Shop" opened on a street in Xinzhuang where the rent is reasonable.

In the early days, there were only two people in the store, Bai Weixiu and Xu Anan. In order to help introduce relatives, they used the discounts of broken limbs to give each other discounts. As for being unable to rest after get off work, they had to seize the time to create a website and use the Internet to promote it.

As a result, the good reviews spread like this. This is the benefit of the ever-expanding Internet these days. With good reputation and deliberate publicity, "One Life" started making money less than a year after its establishment.

But even if it goes so smoothly, Bai Weixiu still has to make a fuss about herself. If she hadn't always been careful about her budget, this won't work, it's too expensive, and that won't work. She has to save a little, and she might not be able to move in the direction of making money so quickly.

Yes, money!

What Bai Weixiu loves most in her life is money. She never regards money as money, but as life!Every time she saw the number in her bankbook increasing, she would feel extremely excited. Whenever she had to collect money and spend it, her heart would bleed.

money!She needs to make money!Make a lot of money!Because she still has many goals to achieve.

She needs money to repay her father and study abroad. Because she is studying fashion design, she is highly interested in white gauze and bridal styling. She also wants to learn more to move herself up the level of a wedding consultant.

As she thought about it, two more $ signs appeared in Bai Weixiu's eyes unconsciously.

But damn it, now that the off-season for weddings is coming, her partners in the store still look indifferent. This is so embarrassing for her half-owner!

Xu An'an, Xiao Zhen, Yu De, and two working-study students looked at Bai Weixiu who was in a tragic situation. They frowned, her mouth twitched, her hands clenched in excitement, and her eyes that suddenly shone but then dimmed. Based on their understanding of her, they knew that she had thought of her favorite thing in her life - money!

Xu Anan shook his head, waved his hand, and told everyone else to go about their business. Even if they had nothing to do, they should find something to occupy themselves with. Then she turned to Bai Weixiu and persuaded her: "Weixiu, can you change your love for money?" Loving money is not a disease, but loving money so much that it is more important than life is a problem.

Xu Anan carefully looked at his good classmate, good friend and partner from head to toe several times.

Bai Weixiu has long black and shiny hair shawl, neatly cut bangs, and a standard oval face. Although her facial features are not gorgeous, the combination is quite perfect. Based on his critical look at women, she can be said to be of average to slightly above average appearance.

What makes people jealous the most is her flawless white skin. People who don’t know may think that she goes to the beauty shop every two days for maintenance, or else spends a lot of money to buy expensive skin care products. Wrong, how can Bai Weixiu, the money slave, spend so much? Her good skin is completely natural beauty, betterThank you so much to her mother. She cleans her face with facial cleanser every day, then pats on lotion. In winter, she can only apply lotion on her cheeks to prevent her cheeks from being too dry. That's all. If it weren't for the fact that makeup is a basic courtesy for receiving guests as a wedding consultant, she would probably come to work without makeup every day.

Moreover, Bai Weixiu insisted on custom-made uniforms when she opened the store, because this would make people feel the professionalism of the wedding shop staff. He thought her idea was good, but sometimes he couldn't help but think that Bai Weixiu was probably doing it to save the trouble and cost of dressing up. Look, there are three styles of uniforms in summer and winter, and they can be worn in rotation at work. How much money can be saved in dressing up. He is indeed a master of budgeting, and he really admires her.

Okay, he digressed again and got back to the topic.

In front of him, Bai Weixiu was wearing a short-sleeved, stand-collared cheongsam-style fitted purple uniform, which fully showed off her slender figure. Speaking of her figure, tsk tsk, it made people more jealous than her flawless skin. He was so jealous that he became angry. With his mentality and gaze of not loving women and comparing women to the same kind, he had to give her a thumbs up.

Bai Weixiu is very tall, about 168cm, and weighs about 50kg, and her flesh is in the places where she should be, such as her breasts and buttocks, while the places where flesh should not be, such as her waist and thighs, are ridiculously slender. She has a perfect combination of big breasts, slender waist, plump hips, and long legs.

By the way, there is a Taiwanese saying that goes like this, "The breasts and waistband are called top buckles." Please forgive him for his poor Taiwanese, but this is really the best adjective for Bai Weixiu.

Let me ask: How could a man ignore such a beauty and let her go?Of course it's impossible!

As far as he knew, there were not a dozen but at least half a dozen men pursuing her, but this young lady had been busy working to make money ever since her relationship in college ended, and he had never shown any interest in men again.

On the other hand, although he opened a shop and was busy at work, his love never stopped because he firmly believed that love was the best way to stay active.

"Money is important, but love is necessary. Don't waste money all day long. Look at the men who want to pursue you, and go out with them to have a meal or drink coffee to relax."

Chapter 1(2)

For a moment, Bai Weixiu was a little confused. The reason was, why did the topic suddenly shift from money to men?The proportions of these two things in her heart are completely different.

After a while, she asked stupidly: "Why?"

Xu Anan was so angry that he almost tore off her head, and threatened angrily, "You asked me why. If you continue like this, your female hormones will be imbalanced, and your whole face will be covered with pimples. You tell me, you will be so ugly."

"No, only men have physical and mental disorders. Falling in love is a lot of trouble. How about eating, drinking coffee, watching movies, and helping each other pick out gifts for a lot of anniversaries? It doesn't cost money? And it might turn out to be a big tragedy." For example, the two relationships she had in college were sweet at the beginning, but ended up with her boyfriend cheating on her.

"Bai Weixiu, you are really hopeless!"

"Xu An'an, it's not like you don't know that I'm really hopeless!" Bai Weixiu rolled her eyes.

Xu Anan was so angry that she stamped her feet.This is another flaw in Bai Weixiu's personality. She always has a good temper and is easy to get along with in front of customers and people she is not familiar with. Even when she meets an Aoke, she can maintain a gentle smile and try her best to meet the other person's needs. However, people who are familiar with her, let alone him, a long-time friend, are often so angry that she gnashes their teeth at how rude and straightforward she is.

Of course, this is not to say that Bai Weixiu is not good. She is sincere and loyal to her friends, but her attitude changes before and after. She can really win the Oscar for Best Actress.

"Bai Weixiu, the gentle attitude you pretend to have in front of guests is so different from your nature. I'm really worried that one day you will have a schizophrenia."
